question: Does an R1 pullback-confirmation event add future signed cash-index return beyond an otherwise similar intact parent-trend state, and where in the subsequent price path does that incremental return accrue?

event_definition.entry: next observed 1m close after causal R1 confirmation
event_definition.thresholds: unchanged certified R1 S1/S2/S3 thresholds already used by INDEX_PRICE_VALIDITY_FREEZE@1.0

matched_control_definition.purpose: estimate generic intact-parent directional continuation without the current R1 confirmation event
matched_control_definition.control_clock: any observed 1m entry index in the same 2021-2025 window with a causally available same-scale parent pair at index-1 and at least 240 future observed bars
matched_control_definition.feature_timing: all control features use information available no later than entry_idx-1
matched_control_definition.standardization: within symbol+cell+calendar_year, median/MAD on the eligible control pool; MAD scaled by 1.4826, fallback to standard deviation, then 1.0 if degenerate
matched_control_definition.treatment_exclusion: a control entry cannot itself equal an R1 event entry for the same cell and cannot occur within the previous 240 observed bars after a same-cell R1 event entry

primary_attribution_outputs.paired_incremental_return: event signed simple return minus matched-control signed simple return at each frozen horizon

uncertainty.method: event-day cluster bootstrap of paired incremental mean

primary_attribution_outputs.note: The support flag is horizon-local and does not authorize horizon selection. All horizons must be reported.

price_path_attribution.additive_measure: signed log return in basis points

prohibited: selecting a best horizon from this study
changing matching variables after seeing incremental returns
changing the 30-minute clock bucket after seeing results
adding severity, probability, year, regime, side, or time-of-day filters
ETF/futures/options mapping in this attribution study

interpretation_contract.if_R1_incremental_supported: treat R1 as pullback-specific incremental price alpha beyond generic parent continuation; next work may study carrier transport without reopening signal discovery
interpretation_contract.if_raw_R1_positive_but_incremental_not_s: reinterpret the prior price edge primarily as parent-trend continuation rather than distinct pullback alpha
interpretation_contract.R2: out of scope; prior direct directional price evidence remains unsupported
